text.description_html:
Falcon XX-V-EO, Falcon Reversible Surface Vertical Rod Exit Device

The Falcon XX-V Series Vertical Rod Device is produced to meet the demanding requirements of higher traffic installations. This device is a surface-applied vertical rod type with the traditional crossbar design.

Features and Specifications of the Falcon XX-V Series Surface Vertical Rod Crossbar Exit Device:

  • Crossbar: 1" diameter brass
  • Arms: Forged Brass, aluminum and investment cast stainless steel
  • Latchbolt: Top stainless steel with 3/4" throw, bottom 1/2" throw
  • Projection: 5" maximum; 4" dogged
  • Handing: Reversible, non-handed
  • Door Width: 4'0"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Mounting Height: 40-1/4" from CL to finished floor.
  • Fasteners: All mounting screws are concealed. Sheet metal screws standard.
  • Dogging: 1/2" turn hex dogging standard.
  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Grade 1

Sold Individually
